items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I got married in Chicago at that time to Irene Armstrong, who had been married to Joe Edqy.

ctx.x: And I guess I should mention that I got married in Chicago at that time to Irene Armstrong, who had been married to Joe Edqy. Joe Edqy was operating, or the manager of the El Dorado Club on the southside.
Is that so? I didn't know that.
Irene Edqy, I always knew Irene, Your wife was Irene Edqy.
